blurb: Highland Bowl is a 20 lane family owned Duckpin bowling center. Highland Bowl strives for a great family environment. We have done major upgrades in our center. We are the only Duckpin center in CT to have fully automatic computer scoring, bumper bowling, glow-in-the-dark bowling, a snack bar with beer, wine, liquor service, a new redemption arcade, and BELLA our delivery robot. We are located on Rt. 10 in Cheshire,
